subject.title: fix #95295: [Bug]: Web UI sidebar hides existing child-spawned subagent sessions across agent scopes

question: Should the Control UI sidebar expose persisted child/subagent sessions from every configured agent when the user explicitly enables a sidebar-only “All agents” mode?
rationale: The implementation is isolated and default-off, but it intentionally expands transcript discoverability across agent scopes and no established sidebar policy confirms that boundary.

options.title: Accept sidebar opt-in
options.body: Approve the isolated default-off mode and require current-head real multi-agent browser proof before merge.

options.title: Keep sidebar scoped
options.body: Reject the new mode and keep cross-agent discovery confined to the existing exhaustive Sessions page.

recommendation.title: Accept sidebar opt-in
recommendation.body: Approve the isolated default-off mode and require current-head real multi-agent browser proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work directly owns the current sidebar component and its browser regression coverage.
